messages.text: Hi. Any discount code for a first time buyer getting a globe for their son from Santa? 🙏

I don't have a discount code to offer, and I don't want to invent one — sorry! But I can help make sure Santa picks the right globe. You were looking at the Globemaster 12" Blue Ocean Desk Globe with Silver Metal Base — nice pick for a desk gift. How old is your son?

For a 6-year-old, the 12" Interactive Talking World Globe with Wireless Intelli-Pen is a great fit — it's got a raised relief map kids can feel with their fingers, plus an interactive pen that talks through facts, so it grows with him as he learns geography, not just something to look at. The Globemaster you were viewing is a lovely, more traditional desk globe if you'd rather he "graduate" into something more grown-up looking, but for hands-on learning at 6, the Talking Globe wins. You'll find it under that name in the search bar, ready to add to your cart.
